scripts._build: node scripts/build-arena-headless.mjs && node scripts/check-data.mjs && node scripts/check-daily.mjs && node scripts/check-builder.mjs && node scripts/check-builder-geometry.mjs && node scripts/check-arena.mjs && tsc && vite build
scripts.build:debug: node scripts/build-arena-headless.mjs && vite build --sourcemap --minify false --outDir dist-debug
scripts.preview:debug: npm run build:debug && vite preview --outDir dist-debug --open "/?debug=1"
scripts.build:android: node scripts/build-arena-headless.mjs && node scripts/check-data.mjs && tsc && vite build --mode android && npx cap sync android
scripts.build:android:release: node scripts/build-arena-headless.mjs && node scripts/check-data.mjs && tsc && cross-env VITE_LIVE_ADS=1 vite build --mode android && npx cap sync android
scripts.apk:debug: npm run build:android && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleDebug
scripts.aab:release: npm run build:android:release && cd android && gradlew.bat bundleRelease
scripts.check: node scripts/build-arena-headless.mjs && node scripts/check-data.mjs && node scripts/check-daily.mjs && node scripts/check-builder.mjs && node scripts/check-builder-geometry.mjs && node scripts/check-arena.mjs && tsc --noEmit
